doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.intro: The automated summary says the patient never left the room. I signed it before checking the underlying log.

choices.label: Ask for the original log
choices.reply: The original clock and the summary disagree. Please preserve both.

choices.label: Ask about the diagnosis
choices.reply: A diagnosis cannot tell you who opened a door. Start with the building.

nurse.name: Ward nurse
nurse.intro: The night doors opened during a network restart. I remember a visitor, but the camera remembers an empty corridor.

choices.label: Ask for the shift chronology
choices.reply: The restart came first. The footsteps came later. I wrote them separately.

choices.label: Ask about the visitor
choices.reply: A coat, perhaps. The reflection made it look green. Please do not put certainty in my mouth.

patient.name: Patient
patient.intro: I will talk if I can stop whenever I want. The name was Lakkahaltia. I heard it years ago, before this ward.

choices.label: Listen without suggesting an explanation
choices.reply: Someone waited by the window. Or I remembered someone waiting. Write that down too.

choices.label: Ask whether the screen suggested the name
choices.reply: The screen has been showing old city photographs. I cannot separate the dream from the picture.

record.title: Authorized medical-record extract
record.text: A consented, redacted extract records a corridor visit at 02:14. The automated summary says the patient slept. Neither establishes why.
record.anomalous: A shared interruption in remembered time.

reflection.title: Window reflection
reflection.text: A greenish outline appears beside your reflection. A passing coat, display bleed, or a visitor?

audit.title: Clock comparison
audit.text: The door log precedes the summary by eleven minutes; the discrepancy survives a local export.
audit.mundane: Independent devices drifted during the restart.
audit.anomalous: The witnesses describe the same missing interval.

endings.mundane: Report: system failure remains the working explanation. Preserve the witness accounts and request an independent log audit. As you leave, the corrected summary includes a sentence nobody recalls dictating.
endings.anomalous: Report: retain an unexplained encounter as a hypothesis. Arrange a voluntary follow-up and preserve the original logs. Outside, the green shape resolves into a coat. You cannot tell whether anyone is wearing it.
